text_en: I am speaking the truth in Christ—I am not lying; my conscience confirms it by the Holy Spirit—
text_cn: 我在基督内说实话，并不说谎，有我的良心在圣神内与我一同作证：

text_en: I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
text_cn: 我的忧愁极大，我心中不断的痛苦；

text_en: For I could wish that I myself were accursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my own people, my kindred according to the flesh.
text_cn: 为救我的弟兄，我血统的同胞，就是被诅咒，与基督隔绝，我也甘心情愿。

text_en: They are Israelites, and to them belong the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the worship, and the promises;
text_cn: 他们是以色列人：义子的名分、光荣、盟约、法律、礼仪以及恩许，都是他们的；

text_en: to them belong the patriarchs, and from them, according to the flesh, comes the Messiah, who is over all, God blessed forever. Amen.
text_cn: 圣祖也是他们的，并且基督按血统说，也是从他们来的，他是在万有之上，世世代代应受赞美的天主！阿们。

text_en: It is not as though the word of God had failed. For not all Israelites truly belong to Israel,
text_cn: 这并不是说天主的话落了空，因为不是凡从以色列生的，都是真以色列人；

text_en: and not all of Abraham’s children are his true descendants; but “It is through Isaac that descendants shall be named for you. ”
text_cn: 也不是凡是亚巴郎的后裔，就都是他的真子女，而是“由依撒格所生的，才称为你的后裔，”

text_en: This means that it is not the children of the flesh who are the children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as descendants.
text_cn: 即是说：不是血统上的子女，算是天主的子女，而是藉恩许所生的子女，才算为真后裔。

text_en: For this is what the promise said, “About this time I will return and Sarah shall have a son. ”
text_cn: 原来恩许是这样说的：“到明年这时候我要来，撒辣必有一个儿子。”

text_en: Nor is that all; something similar happened to Rebecca when she had conceived children by one husband, our ancestor Isaac.
text_cn: 并且关于黎贝加也有相似的事。她从我们的先祖依撒格一人怀了孕；

text_en: Even before they had been born or had done anything good or bad (so that God’s purpose of election might continue,
text_cn: 当时双胎还没有出生，也没有行善或作恶；但为使天主预简的计划坚定不移，

text_en: not by works but by his call) she was told, “The elder shall serve the younger. ”
text_cn: 且为显示这计划并不凭人的行为，而只凭天主的召选，遂有话给她说：“年长的要服事年幼的。”

text_en: As it is written, “I have loved Jacob, but I have hated Esau. ”
text_cn: 正如经上记载：“我爱了雅各伯，而恨了厄撒乌。”

text_en: What then are we to say? Is there injustice on God’s part? By no means!
text_cn: 那么，我们可说什么呢？难道天主不公道吗？绝对不是！

text_en: For he says to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion. ”
text_cn: 因为他对梅瑟说过：“我要恩待的，就恩待；我要怜悯的，就怜悯。”

text_en: So it depends not on human will or exertion, but on God who shows mercy.
text_cn: 这样看来，蒙召并不在乎人愿意，也不在乎人努力而是由于天主的仁慈，

text_en: For the scripture says to Pharaoh, “I have raised you up for the very purpose of showing my power in you, so that my name may be proclaimed in all the earth. ”
text_cn: 因为经上有话对法郎说：“我特兴起了你，是为在你身上彰显我的大能，并为使我的名传遍全世界。”

text_en: So then he has mercy on whomever he chooses, and he hardens the heart of whomever he chooses.
text_cn: 这样看来，他愿意恩待谁，就恩待谁；他愿意使谁心硬，就使谁心硬。

text_en: You will say to me then, “Why then does he still find fault? For who can resist his will? ”
text_cn: 或者，你要问我说：既是这样，为什么他还要责怪人呢？有谁能抗拒他的意志呢？

text_en: But who indeed are you, a human being, to argue with God? Will what is molded say to the one who molds it, “Why have you made me like this? ”
text_cn: 人呀！你是谁，竟敢向天主抗辩？制造品岂能对制造者说：你为什么这样制造了我？

text_en: Has the potter no right over the clay, to make out of the same lump one object for special use and another for ordinary use?
text_cn: 难道陶工不能随意用一团泥，把这一个作成贵重的器皿，把那一个作成卑贱的器皿吗？

text_en: What if God, desiring to show his wrath and to make known his power, has endured with much patience the objects of wrath that are made for destruction;
text_cn: 如果天主愿意显示自己的义怒，并彰显自己的威能，曾以宽宏大量，容忍了那些惹他发怒而应受毁灭的器皿；

text_en: and what if he has done so in order to make known the riches of his glory for the objects of mercy, which he has prepared beforehand for glory—
text_cn: 他如此作，是为把他那丰富的光荣，在那些他早已准备好，为进入光荣而蒙怜悯的器皿身上彰显出来，又有什么不可呢？

text_en: including us whom he has called, not from the Jews only but also from the Gentiles?
text_cn: 这些器皿就是我们这些不但从犹太人中，而且也从外邦人中被天主所宠召的人。

text_en: As indeed he says in Hosea, “Those who were not my people I will call ‘my people, ’ and her who was not beloved I will call ‘beloved. ’”
text_cn: 这正如天主在《欧瑟亚》书中所说的：“我要叫‘非我人民’为‘我的人民’，又叫‘不蒙爱怜者’为‘蒙爱怜者’；

text_en: “And in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people, ’ there they shall be called children of the living God. ”
text_cn: 人在那里对他们说：你们不是我的人民，在同样的地方，他们要被称为永生天主的子女。”

text_en: And Isaiah cries out concerning Israel, “Though the number of the children of Israel were like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will be saved;
text_cn: 论到以色列，依撒意亚却呼喊说：“以色列子民的数目虽然多如海沙，唯有残存者要蒙受救恩，

text_en: for the Lord will execute his sentence on the earth quickly and decisively. ”
text_cn: 因为上主在大地上，要彻底迅速完成他的判决。”

text_en: And as Isaiah predicted, “If the Lord of hosts had not left survivors to us, we would have fared like Sodom and been made like Gomorrah. ”
text_cn: 依撒意亚又预言过：“若非万军的上主给我们留下苗裔，我们早已如同索多玛，相似哈摩辣了。”

text_en: What then are we to say? Gentiles, who did not strive for righteousness, have attained it, that is, righteousness through faith;
text_cn: 那么，我们可说什么呢？外邦人没有追求正义，却获得了正义，即由信仰而得的正义；

text_en: but Israel, who did strive for the righteousness that is based on the law, did not succeed in fulfilling that law.
text_cn: 以色列人追求使人成义的法律，却没有得到这种法律，

text_en: Why not? Because they did not strive for it on the basis of faith, but as if it were based on works. They have stumbled over the stumbling stone,
text_cn: 这是为什么呢？是因为他们不凭信仰，只凭着行为追求。他们正碰在那块绊脚石上，

text_en: as it is written, “See, I am laying in Zion a stone that will make people stumble, a rock that will make them fall, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame. ”
text_cn: 正如经上所载：“看，我在熙雍按放了一块绊脚石，一块使人绊跌的磐石；相信他的人，不至蒙羞。”
